description: This file contains unit tests for the utility functions related to handling logic hooks in SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM, including testing functions like get_hook_array, replace_or_add_logic_type, write_logic_file, and build_logic_file.

classes.name: logic_utilsTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing utility functions related to logic hooks in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: testget_hook_array
methods.description: Tests the get_hook_array function with valid and invalid module names.

methods.name: check_existing_elementProvider
methods.description: Provides test data for checking if an element exists in the hook array.

methods.name: testcheck_existing_element
methods.description: Tests the check_existing_element function for existing and non-existing hooks.

methods.name: testreplace_or_add_logic_type
methods.description: Verifies that the replace_or_add_logic_type function generates the correct hook PHP code.

methods.name: testwrite_logic_file
methods.description: Tests the write_logic_file function: creates a file, verifies its content, and reads back the hook array.

methods.name: testbuild_logic_file
methods.description: Verifies that build_logic_file generates the expected PHP code string from hook array.
